Job Description Are you passionate about data analytics, investigating fraud, and combining strong technical skills with a risk mindset to uncover actionable insights from complex datasets? If so, you might be the right candidate for the Analyst, Fraud Data Analytics and Insights position within Fidelity’s Fraud Risk and Control (FRC) organization. The Role Responsibilities In this role, your focus will be on supporting data analytics across the Fraud Risk and Control organization. Your responsibilities include: Data analysis for fraud prevention, risk assessments, controls, and policy decisions Operational reporting for global operations and fraud loss and analytical trends Build Fidelity-specific fraud and scam domain expertise, striving to become an expert in Fidelity’s complex business and the vast customer, transaction, trading data environment Communicate analysis, collaborate with and provide recommendations to stakeholders within the fraud risk and control organization and to partners across enterprise cyber security The Expertise And Skills You Bring Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative, analytics, or technical field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics). 2 plus years’ experience in the financial services industry. Fraud or risk related experience preferred. Hands‑on experience using SQL and analytical platforms to work with large, complex, structured, unstructured datasets to deliver actionable insights. Experience with Python or other programming languages preferred. Familiarity with ETL tools such as SnapLogic, Alteryx, Informatica. Proven experience with data exploration and visualizations (Power BI or Tableau). Prior project experience leveraging financial transaction, trading, customer data preferred. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data patterns and resolve complex business problems. Ability to manage multiple priorities and shift gears across a variety of responsibilities. Focus on execution by proactively identifying, communicating, and removing impediments to progress. You are motivated, ask questions, thrive in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment, and have a drive for continuous learning The Team The FRC organization, within Enterprise Cyber Security, is responsible for preventing, detecting, responding to, and investigating fraud incidents across the entire Fidelity enterprise. The FRC data analytics team supports reporting and analytics across the prevention/controls space, global operations performance analytics, fraud loss trends and analytical analysis into recent fraud events. Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles. Certifications Category: Business Analytics and Insights Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. We forecast races, test ads at scale, and use AI to track what's breaking in the news, then help campaigns respond fast with messages that actually move voters. Our work has guided how hundreds of millions of dollars are spent by the country's top campaigns and progressive organizations. We're a small, mission-driven team of engineers, data scientists, and political strategists who build fast, experiment boldly, and care deeply about using technology for good.</p> <p><strong>Software Engineer (LLM Products)</strong><br>The 2028 cycle starts the day after the midterms, and a wide-open Democratic presidential primary will begin almost immediately. With a crowded field and a fragmented media environment, campaigns will need to understand what's reaching and persuading voters faster than ever, and our tools will be at the center of that work from the first days of the primary through the general election.</p> <p>We're hiring a product-focused engineer to help build a new generation of AI-powered products: conversational interfaces, autonomous research agents, and tools that turn large amounts of data into information a person can act on in seconds. You’ll be talking to internal and external users to understand their goals. You’ll be working with our political research team to understand how they develop strategic guidance. You’ll turn that into product ideas, UX designs, and production code. This role is for a builder-designer who is just as comfortable in Figma as in a codebase. You'll be joining at the start of the cycle, with time to build systems that are ready before the pressure peaks rather than scrambling to catch up.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build end-to-end features for products where an agent and humans are working together.</li> <li>Build products that present AI-generated output, uncertainty, and citations in a way people actually trust.</li> <li>Work closely with political researchers, data scientists, and other engineers to turn ambiguous problems into simple, usable software.</li> <li>Use AI tools and coding agents to move fast, and know when a slicker interface actually matters versus when it’s polish nobody needs.</li> <li>Talk to users and internal stakeholders to understand what’s confusing, slow, or untrustworthy about existing tools, and fix it.</li> <li>Dive head first into the world of political strategy to build systems that encode a deep understanding of the user’s goals and thought processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our ideal candidate likely:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Has 6+ years of experience as a product engineer, full-stack engineer, or designer-engineer hybrid, with a portfolio of shipped products you can point to.</li> <li>Has strong product and UX instincts: you can critique a flow, sketch an alternative, and explain the tradeoff in plain language.</li> <li>Is comfortable using coding agents to build quickly, but without compromising quality.&nbsp;</li> <li>Has hands-on experience building products on top of LLMs: chat interfaces, agents, retrieval-augmented tools.</li> <li>Understand how to use human annotations efficiently to encode human expertise into AI systems.</li> <li>Has an eye for visual and interaction design; familiarity with tools like Figma is a plus.</li> <li>Is energized by ambiguous problems.</li> <li>Is motivated by Blue Rose Research’s mission and interested in learning the progressive political ecosystem. Prior political or civic-tech experience is welcome but not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Join us!</strong></p> <p>We are a remote-first company with an office in NYC and regular team meetups. We primarily work East Coast hours.</p> <p>The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $210,000 annually, commensurate with experience.</p> <p>We offer medical, dental, vision, 401k match, 20 weeks paid parental leave, fertility and family-building support through Maven Clinic, and unlimited PTO.</p> <p>You don't need to meet every qualification to apply. jobs.jd_excerpt: <p><strong>About us:</strong><br><a href="https://blueroseresearch.org/">Blue Rose Research</a> builds data and AI tools that help Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We forecast races, test ads at scale, and use AI to track what's breaking in the news, then help campaigns respond fast with messages that actually move voters. Our work has guided how hundreds of millions of dollars are spent by the country's top campaigns and progressive organizations. We're a small, mission-driven team of engineers, data scientists, and political strategists who build fast, experiment boldly, and care deeply about using technology for good.</p> <p><strong>Product-Focused Data Scientist (LLM Products)</strong><br>The 2028 cycle starts the day after the midterms, and a wide-open Democratic presidential primary will begin almost immediately. With a crowded field and a fragmented media environment, campaigns will need to understand what's reaching and persuading voters faster than ever, and our tools will be at the center of that work from the first days of the primary through the general election.</p> <p>We're hiring a product-focused data scientist to help build the LLM-powered research and analysis tools behind that effort. You'll co-evolve the product experience along with the models that power it, working with political strategists to turn new AI capabilities into tools that are accurate, well-grounded, and useful. You'll be joining at the start of the cycle, with time to build systems that are ready before the pressure peaks rather than scrambling to catch up.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spend time with political strategists to understand how they think and what AI can do to improve their work..</li> <li>Translate that work into product decisions: how to structure workflows that involve humans and agents working together.&nbsp;</li> <li>Help set the bar for rigor on what “good” looks like for an AI system, while staying pragmatic about what a real deadline and a real user actually need.</li> <li>Design evaluations and LLM-as-judge systems that tell us whether an LLM-powered feature is accurate, well-grounded, and useful.</li> <li>Prototype quickly, using coding agents to test ideas before they become product commitments.</li> <li>Communicate findings and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences, including in client-facing settings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our ideal candidate likely:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Has 5+ years of experience as a data scientist or applied statistician, with lots of exposure to shipping features or products, not just producing analyses.</li> <li>Is proficient in Python, SQL, and standard statistical/ML tooling, and comfortable with the mess of real-world data.</li> <li>Has hands-on experience evaluating or building on top of LLMs: designing eval sets, building LLM-as-judge pipelines, and working with embeddings.</li> <li>Has good product instincts. Cares deeply about how the end user is going to interact with the model through the product.&nbsp;</li> <li>Communicates clearly in writing and in conversation with engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders alike.</li> <li>Is energized by ambiguous problems — translating “help win elections” into a model, a metric, or a product decision, without a clean playbook to follow.</li> <li>Is motivated by Blue Rose Research’s mission and interested in learning the progressive political ecosystem. Prior political or civic-tech experience is welcome but not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Join us!</strong></p> <p>We are a remote-first company with an office in NYC and regular team meetups. We primarily work East Coast hours.</p> <p>The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $210,000 annually, commensurate with experience.</p> <p>We offer medical, dental, vision, 401k match, 20 weeks paid parental leave, fertility and family-building support through Maven Clinic, and unlimited PTO.</p> <p>You don't need to meet every qualification to apply. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.</p> <p>Candidates must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States.</p>

jobs.jd_excerpt: Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health. Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage. Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners. As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission. We are looking for a customer-centric and detail-oriented Data Analyst II to join the Customer Reporting team . Reporting to the Manager, Customer Reporting , you will be responsible for delivering custom and standard reporting that demonstrates the impact of Spring Health to its customers. You will collaborate closely with Customer Success and Subject Matter Experts to refine Spring’s storytelling strategy and data artifacts. This role is expected to support a combination of ad hoc requests and dashboard development. Please note that this is a hybrid role based in San Francisco , with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 44 Montgomery Street location. Candidates must be based in the San Francisco metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites. Periodic travel of up to 25% is expected for team collaboration and company events. If you are passionate about using data to create meaningful impact and thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment, we would love to hear from you. What You’ll Do Delivering analyses and dashboards to customers and internal stakeholders they need to tell compelling stories about Spring Health’s impact Diving into different data sources, quickly building expertise on what is possible, and developing creative solutions based on your stakeholder’s needs Developing a deep understanding of our products and how we tell the story of their impact to customers Collaborate with Product to inform how we evolve our customer data story and expand our standard suite of reporting Surface opportunities to automate and scale commonly requested reports and data sets Become an expert working with our data stack including Snowflake, Looker, dbt, and Hex What Success Looks Like Customers and internal stakeholders are highly satisfied with the quality of work produced Customers and internal stakeholders trust the data provided to them; reports and data sets are reviewed for data consistency and data quality Requests are completed in a timely manner while still prioritizing a high standard of quality Bring ideas forward that can reduce the amount of time spent manually pulling data to inform decisions Dashboards and analyses deliver ongoing value to stakeholders What You’ll Bring You are strong with SQL and are able to effectively query data across many sources You have 3+ years of working experience working with data, data visualization, and dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, PowerBI, Tableau, etc. Strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail You focus on impact, finding the things you can deliver that deliver the most value for your stakeholders You have exceptional communication skills, are comfortable explaining technical concepts to a non-technical audience You are humble, highly motivated, and thrive in fast-paced environments You have a passion for successfully navigating ambiguous problem areas and learning new approaches Prior experience with R is nice to have Prior experience with dbt is nice to have You are passionate about changing the face of mental health care, and Spring Health’s mission to remove all barriers to mental health resonates with you Ability to travel periodically ( Benefits Provided By Spring Health Note : We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. jobs.jd_excerpt: Job Description Dr. Andrew Hung is looking for a Research Data Scientist to join a diverse team! The Research Data Scientist participates in biomedical research projects using programming, data mining, statistics, machine learning, and visualization techniques to lead the development, evaluation, and/or application of algorithms, methods, and software for data analysis. Responsibilities include querying databases, data processing, data cleaning and quality control, supervised and unsupervised machine learning, parametric and nonparametric statistical methods, deploying production models, and leading the communication of scientific findings via peer-reviewed publications and scientific conferences. Writes clean, performant, reusable code managed on GitHub to perform repeatable analyses and to train and deploy models to multiple environments. Principal Responsibilities: Leads the development, evaluation, and/or application of computational and statistical methods including artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms and software for the analysis of biomedical data. Leads with the presentation and communication of scientific results through laboratory meetings, scientific conferences, and peer-reviewed publications. Creates database-to-deployment pipelines for models using the necessary programming languages (primarily R, Python, SQL, neo4j). jobs.jd_excerpt:
Build the systems that define what "good" means for AWS documentation — and that measure whether AI agents are actually producing it. You'll work on an automated quality and governance engine that scores documentation across dimensions like readability, accessibility, link integrity, security, and discoverability, and on the evaluation platform that grades the AI agents now authoring and reviewing that content. You'll also own the shared metadata service that answers "what do we actually know about this page?" — one API where many producing systems write typed, versioned metadata about pages and the sections inside them, and every consumer reads the complete cross-producer picture in a single call instead of integrating with each producer separately. And you'll build the front door to our AI-first content platform: a home page and AI chat assistant, available both in the browser and in chat, that answers documentation questions for thousands of internal builders using retrieval over a knowledge graph and large language models. This is applied AI with a hard measurement problem at its center. Millions of AWS customers read the content your systems evaluate, and the engineers and writers who produce it rely on your quality signals every day. Key job responsibilities - Build and extend automated quality checks that score documentation across measurable dimensions, exposed through APIs and agent tooling so problems are caught while content is being written - Build and operate the AI evaluation platform — golden datasets, model-as-judge scoring, and regression gates — that teams use to prove an AI agent is good enough to ship and to catch regressions when models change - Extend the rules layer that turns quality scores into pass, warn, and block decisions, with configurable thresholds, automated ticketing, and self-healing remediation - Build and evolve the shared metadata service for pages and sections — namespaced multi-producer writes, typed and versioned records, single-call cross-producer reads, change events for downstream consumers, and the search and discovery layer on top of it - Build features on the platform home page and its AI chat assistant across web and chat surfaces, including response streaming, conversational context, and feedback collection - Own operational excellence for production services: on-call, availability and latency targets, and cost - Partner with content strategy, product management, and applied science teams to turn quality standards into rules a machine can measure and enforce A day in the life You'll start your day looking at quality signals from overnight runs — did a new check fire on more pages than expected, is a model-generated classification drifting, did the chat assistant's answer quality dip after a model upgrade? You might dig into a check that's reporting false positives, then tune its thresholds and remediation guidance so writers get advice they can act on rather than noise. Much of your week is building. You'll add a new quality dimension end to end, from the analysis logic through the API and agent-facing tooling, wire a team's AI agent into the evaluation platform so their agent gets scored against a curated dataset on every change, or onboard a new producer onto the metadata service so its data reaches every consumer without anyone building another integration. When an evaluation says an agent got worse, you'll help figure out whether the agent, the judge, or the dataset is wrong — that ambiguity is the interesting part of the job. You'll work directly with content strategists who define quality standards, product managers who own quality and governance outcomes, and engineers on peer teams whose AI agents your evaluations grade. Your customers are the writers, service teams, and AI agents producing AWS documentation — and ultimately the millions of AWS customers who read it. About the team The Content Platform team builds the quality, governance, and evaluation infrastructure for AWS's documentation ecosystem. Our quality service scores content against measurable dimensions and returns results to authors and AI agents in seconds. Our rules layer turns those scores into decisions about what ships. Our evaluation platform is how the wider organization proves an AI system is good enough to release — a shared capability rather than something every team rebuilds. Our metadata service is the single place to ask what any system knows about a documentation page or section, and the substrate that quality, search, and analytics systems build on. We also own the home page and AI chat assistant for our content platform, the entry point where builders start authoring sessions, publish documentation, and ask questions in the browser or in chat. We're part of the organization responsible for the AWS Documentation website and the AI-first content platform behind it. The team values pragmatic engineering, operational excellence, and making quality the default rather than an afterthought.

Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">An active role at the intersection of artificial These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The privilege of working These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">An active role at the intersection of artificial These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">An active role at the intersection of artificial jobs.jd_excerpt: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong>&nbsp;The&nbsp;<strong>United States base salary</strong>&nbsp;range for this full-time position is These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">An active role at the intersection of artificial These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong>&nbsp;The&nbsp;<strong>United States base salary</strong>&nbsp;range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience</p> <p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,<br>leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.</p> <p>We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.</li> <li>Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.</li> <li>Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.</li> <li>Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.</li> </ul> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li jobs.jd_excerpt:
Amazon Healthcare Security (HealthSec) protects patient data across Amazon Health Services. We are looking for Software Development Engineers to build the platforms that let our security agents and engineers work at machine speed without compromising how that data is handled. You will design, build and operate production services on AWS. Two areas need you most. The first is Context Fabric, the governed data control plane our security agents use to read and write security context, with entitlement, classification and audit on every call. The second is access-control enforcement for patient data: integrating Amazon’s attribute-based access control platform into healthcare services, with shadow-mode rollout, fail-closed behavior and clinical override paths. You will own features end to end, from design through on-call, and work with security engineers who turn their judgment into rules your systems enforce. Key job responsibilities • Design, implement and deploy secure, highly available services and APIs on AWS (for example API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Fargate and Step Functions) • Build integrations with Amazon security systems such as Shepherd, Veritas and attribute-based access control, with clear failure behavior and observability • Write design documents and lead design reviews for features you own; review peers’ code and designs • Build testing into the work: unit and integration tests, mutation-tested guards, and canary or shadow rollouts before enforcement • Operate what you build, including metrics, alarms, runbooks and on-call • Use AI coding assistants and agentic tooling as part of how you build, and help shape how the team uses them About the team HealthSec Foundry is the security backbone for Amazon Health Services (AHS): Amazon Pharmacy, One Medical, PillPack and Virtual Health Services. We build the tooling, automation, platforms and pipelines that let AHS scale securely, and we build them AI-first. Our work includes Context Fabric, the governed data control plane for HealthSec’s security agents; agent-based security tooling that delivers guidance and fixes inside builders’ IDEs and code reviews; and access-control enforcement for patient data built on Amazon’s attribute-based access control platform. We serve every HealthSec pillar and partner with Amazon-wide security programs rather than duplicating them. Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

We are seeking an Applied Scientist to lead the development of evaluation frameworks and data collection protocols for robotic capabilities. In this role, you will focus on designing how we measure, stress-test, and improve robot behavior across a wide range of real-world tasks. Your work will play a critical role in shaping how policies are validated and how high-quality datasets are generated to accelerate system performance. You will operate at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and human-in-the-loop systems, building the infrastructure and methodologies that connect teleoperation, evaluation, and learning. This includes developing evaluation policies, defining task structures, and contributing to operator-facing interfaces that enable scalable and reliable data collection. The ideal candidate is highly experimental, systems-oriented, and comfortable working across software, robotics, and data pipelines, with a strong focus on turning ambiguous capability goals into measurable and actionable evaluation systems. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure robot capabilities across structured tasks, edge cases, and real-world scenarios - Develop task definitions, success criteria, and benchmarking methodologies that enable consistent and reproducible evaluation of policies - Create and refine data collection protocols that generate high-quality, task-relevant datasets aligned with model development needs - Build and iterate on teleoperation workflows and operator interfaces to support efficient, reliable, and scalable data collection - Analyze evaluation results and collected data to identify performance gaps, failure modes, and opportunities for targeted data collection - Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate evaluation tooling, logging systems, and data pipelines into the broader robotics stack - Stay current with advances in robotics, evaluation methodologies, and human-in-the-loop learning to continuously improve internal approaches - Lead technical projects from conception through production deployment - Mentor junior scientists and engineers About the team Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces. We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build. If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Annapurna Labs is an integral part of AWS and develops hardware and software components that are critical building blocks for EC2 infrastructure. We specialize in designing software, systems and chips that optimize the AWS customer experience. The AWS Neuron Collectives team is seeking a Software Engineer to optimize collective operations for AWS Trainium. Trainium is one of Amazon's highest priority initiatives, powering the frontier AI models being trained today. Collectives are the critical operations that scale AI compute across the data center. You'll work in depth to optimize compute for the specific topologies used to train modern LLMs. Working closely with the hardware team, you'll push for maximum performance using C/C++, interfacing with DMA and firmware and investigating detailed topologies. You'll analyze current collective algorithms using publicly accessible tools like Neuron Explorer and optimize these to fully utilize compute and bus bandwidth to scale across the data center. This is a unique opportunity to impact how AI training runs at AWS scale, while growing your technical breadth and depth. Key job responsibilities As a Neuron Collectives Software Developer, you will: * Enhance collective algorithms and topologies for optimal training performance * Use tools like Neuron Explorer to identify bottlenecks in compute and bus bandwidth utilization * Monitor and analyze processor, DMA, firmware, and workload metrics * Optimize collective operations to scale AI compute across the data center * Work closely with the hardware team to co-optimize software and Trainium silicon * Develop and optimize C/C++ implementations of collective communication patterns * Investigate and implement improvements for specific training topologies used by modern LLMs * Build and maintain analysis frameworks and automation solutions The role offers opportunities to work on cutting-edge AI training hardware while contributing to one of Amazon's most critical initiatives. jobs.jd_excerpt: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture. Preferred locations for team members for our Data Platform roles are our San Francisco or Seattle hubs. About Superhuman Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. The Opportunity As a Data Engineer on the Business Unit (BU) Pod supporting Go , you’ll build the pipelines and data models that help us understand how people use Superhuman’s proactive AI assistant. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to give teams the data they need to improve the product and measure its impact. Go helps people where they already work, through conversations, inline suggestions, and built-in and custom agents. Understanding how people use these experiences takes more than counting clicks. Your work will help teams see where users get stuck, which capabilities they find useful, and what brings them back. It will also help connect Go’s usage to customer adoption and business growth. You’ll own projects and datasets with a clear scope, supported by experienced engineers. Most of your work will focus on production pipelines and reusable data models that teams can use to answer their own questions. You’ll also contribute analysis and dashboards when they help move a decision forward. As you learn the product and our systems, you’ll have opportunities to take on more complex work. What You’ll Do Build and maintain production data pipelines in Databricks that process product events, user activity, and agent interactions across Go. Develop datasets for onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and conversion so teams can work from consistent metrics. Work with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to define what needs to be measured, improve event logging, and check that new features are represented correctly in downstream data. Make data models easy to understand and use, with clear definitions and documentation that support self-service through analytics and AI tools. Build focused analyses and dashboards when they help partners use the data or make a decision. Connect Go usage with customer and account data to help teams understand adoption, customer value, and Go’s contribution to growth and revenue. Keep the datasets you own accurate, up-to-date, and reliable. Add tests and monitoring, investigate discrepancies, and fix the underlying causes. Improve pipeline and query performance, manage compute costs, and make the code you work on easier to maintain. You’ll work alongside engineers and partners across Data Platform and Go. We care about understanding the problem, questioning assumptions, and following through when the answer takes some digging. You’ll contribute to design decisions and have teammates to turn to as you build your expertise. Qualifications You have 2+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines, ideally for product analytics or other critical business use cases. You’re highly proficient in SQL and have experience writing, debugging, and optimizing transformations in a modern lakehouse or cloud data warehouse such as Databricks or Snowflake. You understand data modeling and warehouse design, and can turn complex source data into tables that others can understand and reuse. You test your work carefully, investigate unexpected results, and trace data issues back to their source. You have experience with workflow orchestration, version control, and deployment practices for data pipelines, using tools such as Databricks Workflows, Airflow, and Git. You use AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor, and take responsibility for testing and validating the code they produce. You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners. You can turn a product question into data requirements and explain the assumptions and limitations behind an answer. You’re curious about how people use products and how your work can help teams make better decisions. You follow your work through to production, break problems into manageable steps, raise risks and dependencies early, and ask for help when you need it. Nice to have Experience using Python and/or Spark for data transformations, pipelines, or automation. Experience with product or growth analytics, including adoption funnels, retention, conversion, or A/B experiments. Experience working with event logging and behavioral data from web, desktop, or mobile products. Experience supporting AI products or agents, including measuring adoption, interaction quality, reliability, latency, or usage costs. Experience building dashboards or other data tools that product, analytics, and business teams use to answer their own questions. Compensation And Benefits Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) Disability and life insurance options 401(k) and RRSP matching Paid parental leave 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time

By utilizing enhanced automatic speech recognition, human captioning, and innovative product development, we deliver easy-to-use, cutting-edge technology to our primarily senior customer base. Our near real-time phone captioning technology allows individuals with hearing loss to see what callers are saying, enabling them to regain their connection to the world. ClearCaptions is a Federal Communications Commission (FCC)-certified telephone captioning provider, adhering to the highest industry standards of privacy, security, and professionalism. Summary: The Data Analyst collaborates with key organizational leaders, including the C-suite, to deliver cohesive, rigorous, and insightful reporting tools and in-depth analyses that facilitate data-driven decision making. This role translates complex data into clear, actionable insights that align with strategic business goals, while collaborating across technical and non-technical teams to foster a culture of data literacy and democratization. The role serves as a trusted thought-partner and problem-solver, bridging the gap between data and strategy to support impactful business outcomes. What This Role Does: Works collaboratively with internal teams to solve cross-functional business challenges and provide key insights that drive improvement for both the business and its customers. Translates analyses into actionable, data-backed recommendations and summaries of expected results. Analyzes operational initiatives to measure their effectiveness and impact on key performance indicators (KPIs), enables in-depth understanding of existing performance, and recommends process optimizations based on a data-driven analysis of expected results Conducts deep-dive root cause analyses (RCA) to determine key drivers of performance, observed changes, and trends. Develops, refines, and leverages cross-functional dashboards and reports to provide timely data for decision-making, as well as regular performance updates to stakeholders. Collects, integrates, and interprets cross-functional and disparate data sets to provide holistic insights, recommendations, and analysis of business value impact across the acquisition funnel, including marketing, sales, and operations. Prototypes and develops PoC tools to enable deeper organizational understanding of performance, year-over-year pacing, and progress against goals. Leverages advanced analytics modeling, including regression, forecasting, segmentation, and similar methodologies, to deliver significant and rigorous business insights. Supports A/B and experimental test design; leads analysis of test data and delivery of actionable results using rigorous statistical analysis methodologies Maintains a detailed understanding of platforms, data structures, and data architecture to serve as a reliable organizational resource and contribute to the evolution of analytics capabilities and frameworks. Partners closely with Data Engineering and Reporting teams to communicate and collaborate on complex data needs and projects supporting business requirements, automation initiatives, and metric alignment. Independently determines and pursues deep-dive opportunities for ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics to provide insights and recommendations to key business leaders. Serves as a key partner with internal team members to refine and optimize organizational performance efforts. Develops calculation models, wireframes, and requirements for Data Engineering and Reporting developers in support of initiatives related to the automation of data pipelines and automated, dynamic reporting tools. Maintains data dictionaries, metric definitions, event mapping, and documentation of data sources. Ensures data security and compliance with data privacy regulations. Performs other duties as assigned. What You Will Bring: A bachelor’s degree in business, economics, statistics, analytics or a related field is required. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered. A minimum of five (5) years in a role with demonstrated analytical background and expertise (e.g., data analysis, business analytics, statistical analysis, forecasting/demand management). Proficiency in data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, DAX, Python, and/or R with advanced skill in Excel. Strong data visualization skills using Power BI and/or Tableau as well as for storytelling in presentations of results to organizational leadership. Excellent analytical and statistical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy. Solid understanding of statistical concepts and data analysis techniques, including evaluation of ROI and attribution, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and forecasting methodology. Demonstrated proficiency with a broad range of technologies
