Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. Are you passionate about developing software applications and services for an advanced global connectivity system? Join the Amazon Leo Satellite Engineering and Mechanicals Development team at the forefront of AI-assisted electrical design for next-generation satellite hardware. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities As a SDE II on th team - You will design, develop, and maintain scalable services and tools across our AI-assisted electrical design toolset: schematic design review, design and connectivity queries, component and datasheet intelligence, and design vault integration. - You will own end-to-end delivery of features, from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment in AWS. - You will build and optimize data pipelines and APIs that support electrical engineering workflows, enabling traceability from each design version to the components and datasheets behind it. - You will collaborate with electrical and hardware engineers to translate domain needs into robust, maintainable software solutions. - You will drive integration efforts across engineering tools (e.g., Siemens Xpedition and its design vault) and internal platform services to ensure seamless data flow. - You will contribute to AI-driven capabilities such as automated schematic review, natural-language design queries, and cited component specifications. - You will participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and operational excellence initiatives. - You will mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and ownership. - You will troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high availability and reliability of platform services. A day in the life As a Software Development Engineer on the team, the candidate will lead the design, architecture, and implementation of critical tools and services powering the satellite electrical design lifecycle. These tools span schematic design review, design data search, component and datasheet intelligence, and design vault integration. The candidate's work will directly impact Amazon's ability to scale satellite hardware development efficiently and effectively across engineering teams. About the team The Leo Space Engineering Applications (LSEA) team specializes in building and maintaining secure engineering solutions that optimize satellite product development processes, including AI-assisted tools for electrical design.

jobs.jd_excerpt: How to apply: please apply through our website at https://www.arrepath.com/careers/ , where we ask two short questions about how you use coding agents and what agentic systems you've built. ArrePath is a fully remote startup using AI to discover new classes of oral small-molecule drugs. We work in antibacterials, mycobacterial lung disease, immunology, and inflammation. Our platform has found inhibitors of six new antibacterial targets. Our team has helped discover, develop, or obtain approval for nine antibiotics. Our investors include Insight Partners, Innospark Ventures, and the Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund. Ariadne is our AI scientific assistant. It is an agent with persistent memory, a web chat interface, and a single MCP gateway that brokers access to compute on AWS (Batch, Lambda, S3), external scientific APIs, and our internal data. It also includes a multi-stage literature search pipeline and an evaluation harness for measuring agent behavior. It gives our scientists natural-language access to more than 30 machine-learning models and cheminformatics tools. They use it to run computational chemistry workflows, search the scientific and patent literature, query internal assay data, and analyze results in conversation multiple times per day. The role We’re hiring an engineer to be the second developer on Ariadne. You’ll work directly with Kurt Thorn, our CTO, who leads Ariadne development, and with the scientists who use it every day. ArrePath is a small company, so you’ll get direct exposure to the leadership team. On a two-person team you own work end to end. That means taking a bug report or feature request from a scientist, designing the change, building it with coding agents, validating it, and shipping it to production. There’s no product manager, QA team, or separate ops group. You’ll be the person who decides how something should work and makes sure it does. What you’ll work on Your main focus will be making Ariadne more autonomous, reliable, and robust: Memory: what the agent retains across sessions, and how it retrieves and uses it File tracking: keeping track of the data files, results, and artifacts a scientist works with over a long project Reasoning: planning and staying on course through long, multi-step scientific tasks Tool execution: choosing the right tools, calling them correctly, and recovering when they fail Delegation: handing work off to sub-agents and combining what they return Web interface: improving the TypeScript and Vite chat app where it limits what scientists can do The stack is Python, TypeScript, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, and LLMs from several providers via Amazon Bedrock. How we work Two humans and a fleet of coding agents build Ariadne. Most of our code is written by agents such as Claude Code and Codex, running in parallel. Our job is to direct them well and to be accountable for what ships. In practice: Humans own design and judgment. Bounded changes get a short design review. Architectural changes get a written spec and an implementation plan before any code is written. Tests and evidence over assertions. We practice TDD for behavior and verify agent claims against real results. Written invariants. Component specs record the invariants that matter, and tooling checks code against them. Cross-model review. We use reviewers from different model families to stress-test designs and diffs. Repository rules agents follow. Our CLAUDE.md, skills, and hooks encode how work gets done, and we keep improving them. You’ll help shape this process, not just follow it. If you’ve built your own agentic workflow and have opinions about what works, we want to hear them. What we’re looking for The essential qualification is experience on both sides of agentic software: building agentic systems and using agents to write code. You have: Experience building agentic systems with LLMs: tool use, memory, planning, multi-agent delegation, evals, and the ways these systems fail Substantial hands-on experience using coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) on a real codebase, not just demos The judgment to know when an agent’s output is wrong, the habit of checking, and the discipline to break work into pieces agents can do reliably 2+ years of professional Python or TypeScript experience Clear written communication. Much of the work is writing specs, reviews, and instructions for people and agents. Ability to get productive fast in a large existing codebase. Nice to have: Background in chemistry, biology, or another scientific field Experience with MCP servers or retrieval and search systems Experience training ML models Experience at an early-stage startup

Our approach is discreet, convenient, and affordable. We've been successfully operating in 16 states for almost six years and we're excited to continue our growth. Your contributions will ultimately influence key company domains, including company-level KPIs, clinical, commercial, and business operations, and more. Data is deeply embedded in our corporate culture, with widespread adoption of data products and significant potential for further evolution.</p> <p>In this fully remote position, you will report to our Senior Director of Data and serve as a peer to our analysts and analytics engineers. You'll partner closely with Analytics Engineering to move models from notebook to production, and with the broader Technology Team to cultivate a culture of data-driven decision-making that ultimately enhances patient care.</p> <p>Ophelia's Technology team actively encourages and invests in AI-augmented ways of working: using tools like Claude and Gemini to accelerate coding, analysis, and experimentation, and staying current as the AI landscape evolves. Consistent with Ophelia's AI Position Statement, we treat AI as a force multiplier for our team, not a replacement for human judgment - it's there to help you work at the top of your license, move faster from question to insight, and spend more time on the modeling and reasoning that actually requires a person. You'll be expected to use AI fluently in your own workflow, and to help shape how the larger technology team uses it responsibly and effectively as it evolves.</p> <p>Together, we are dedicated to helping individuals with opioid dependence. While experience in this specific treatment area isn't required, ideally you will possess knowledge of the healthcare landscape, including an understanding of health outcomes, benchmarks, systems, and regulatory compliance (HIPAA).</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Predictive &amp; statistical modeling:</strong> Build, validate, and ship models - demand and clinical-capacity forecasting, no-show and retention risk, outcome and risk prediction - that directly inform clinical and business strategy.</li> <li><strong>Experimentation &amp; causal inference:</strong> Design and analyze experiments and quasi-experiments so the organization can measure true impact, not just correlation.</li> <li><strong>Productionalizing models:</strong> Collaborate with Analytics Engineering and Technology teams to deploy models into robust pipelines (BigQuery, dbt, Dagster) with continuous monitoring, retraining, and drift detection - ensuring models operate as living products.</li> <li><strong>From ambiguity to rigor:</strong> Translate open clinical and operational questions into well-scoped analyses that are mathematically sound and clearly caveated.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Serve as the modeling partner for Clinical, Commercial, and Business Operations - surfacing high-leverage opportunities and communicating results in plain language.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar:</strong> Act as the subject-matter expert for statistical and ML methods, championing rigorous, evidence-based decision-making across the team.</li> </ul> <h2>Skills &amp; Competencies</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Statistical &amp; ML depth:</strong> 3-5+ years of applied data science with a strong foundation in statistics, probability, experimentation, and machine learning. You know when a simple model beats a complex one and how to distinguish signal from noise.</li> <li><strong>Python for data science:</strong> Advanced proficiency in the Python ML/analysis stack (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, gradient-boosting frameworks such as LightGBM/XGBoost, and forecasting methods). Lead tool selection and integration across AI coding assistants, agentic dev environments, automated code review, and AI-assisted testing/QA pipelines — ensuring interoperability with existing CI/CD, IDEs, and version control. The fulfillment team picks, preps, packs, sorts, and ships, products safely, efficiently and effectively to deliver convenience and quality for our guests.    At Target, we believe in our leaders having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. Model, train and coach expectations to deliver the service standard Lead your team and drive fulfillment goals, understand your role in supporting sales growth and how your departments and team contribute to and impact total store profitability, in support of your direct leader Utilize your workload planning tools to ensure your team completes all scheduled workload and all orders are fulfilled to meet the delivery, freshness, and service standards Review all fulfillment reporting to identify gaps and develop a plan to resolve With direction from your direct leader, create daily plans for your team Be an expert of operations, accuracy, process and efficiency Enable efficient delivery to our guests by leading pickup and ship from store workload Evaluate and recommend candidates for open positions and develop a guest-centric team. jobs.jd_excerpt: <p><strong>Your Impact at LILA</strong></p> <p>We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.</p> <p>As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine.</p> <p>Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. We welcome Research Scientists and Research Engineers; responsibilities can span or evolve between the two profiles.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and run capability evaluations of scientific models, agents and tool-mediated workflows (including simulated lab environments), working with domain experts to make tests scientifically meaningful.</li> <li>Create methods or systems that explore diverse failure modes, adapt tests as evidence emerges and support systematic investigation beyond fixed benchmarks.</li> <li>Build reproducible experiments and evaluation tools that capture relevant behavior, outcomes and the evidence needed to interpret findings.</li> <li>Measure the quality and coverage of automated assessments, including failure cases in the evaluators themselves.</li> <li>Develop broader safety automation, across threat model management, evidence triage, regression testing, monitoring workflows or tools that help researchers assess and respond to risks.</li> <li>Collaborate with risk researchers and mitigation engineers to translate findings into improved assessments and safeguards, and verify whether those changes work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong empirical judgment, practical programming ability and experience working with modern AI systems.</li> <li>The ability to investigate ambiguous failures, design informative comparisons and communicate limitations clearly.</li> <li>An interest in scientific misuse risks and the ability to collaborate productively with domain specialists.</li> <li><strong>For the Research Scientist profile:</strong> evidence of selecting valuable research questions, developing or adapting methods, and designing experiments that yield defensible conclusions. You should be able to prototype and test your ideas.</li> <li><strong>For the Research Engineer profile:</strong> evidence of building reliable research software, evaluation infrastructure or agent systems that enable reproducible experiments and efficient iteration. You should be able to contribute to experimental design and interpretation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automated red teaming, adversarial testing or evaluation-method research.</li> <li>Scientific AI, tool-using agents, laboratory automation or other complex environments.</li> <li>Experience with safety monitoring, model-based evaluators or scalable experimental infrastructure.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. jobs.jd_excerpt: Job Description As a Data Engineer II here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will play an essential role in developing and refining data pipelines that facilitate the accurate and efficient flow of information across various systems. Your efforts will be pivotal in enhancing the organization’s ability to access and utilize critical financial data seamlessly. Your primary focus will be on creating robust, scalable solutions that ensure the real-time delivery and automated processing of data from our diverse data sources to endpoint solutions. The role emphasizes collaboration with Finance stakeholders (not enterprise IT architecture) to translate business requirements into reliable, well-documented data products. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines that ingest data from varied sources (financial systems, ERP/CRM, files, APIs) into Snowflake; ensure reliability, observability, and recoverability. Develop transformations using SQL and Python within Dataiku (recipes, flows, scenarios) and Databricks (notebooks, Jobs, Delta Lake/Spark) to produce trusted, reusable finance data marts and subject-area tables. Automate and orchestrate workflows (scheduling, dependency management, alerts) in Dataiku/Databricks; implement robust logging and monitoring. Enable Tableau analytics by publishing performant Snowflake views and semantic layers; optimize query patterns (warehouses, micro-partitions, caching) to support dashboard performance and scalability. Data quality and governance: implement validation rules, reconciliations/tie-outs to source systems, lineage documentation, and access controls; uphold standards for PII and financial data. Requirement gathering & stakeholder collaboration: work directly with Finance/FP&A, Accounting, and business analysts to translate metrics (e.g., period close, variance analysis, forecasting) into data models and pipelines. Performance tuning: leverage Snowflake features (e.g., Tasks, Streams, Dynamic Tables where appropriate), clustering strategies, and cost-efficient warehouse configurations. Version control and CI/CD: manage code in Git, contribute reviews, unit/integration tests, and promote changes through dev/test/prod. Process modernization: convert manual/Excel processes into automated, auditable pipelines; prototype utilities and frameworks in Python Qualifications YOU MUST HAVE US Citizen status Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3–5 years of professional data engineering experience, including 2+ years with Snowflake (data modeling, SQL performance, warehouse administration). Advanced SQL and practical Python skills for data processing and automation. WE VALUE Hands-on experience with Dataiku (flows, recipes, scenarios, plugins) and Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Jobs) for pipeline development and orchestration. Experience preparing datasets for Tableau consumption; familiarity with semantic layers, live vs. extract strategies, and performance best practices. Demonstrated ability to partner with Finance/FP&A teams and translate business logic into reproducible data transformations. Strong documentation habits, communication skills, and commitment to data quality and operational excellence. Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and data services; experience with secrets management and resource cost-optimization. Familiarity with Snowflake Streams, Tasks, and Dynamic Tables for incremental processing and near-real-time use cases. Experience with CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), pytest/unit testing, and environment promotion. Knowledge of data governance (cataloging, lineage, roles/policies) and best practices for financial data controls. Background in finance domain concepts (GL, P&L, balance sheet, budgeting & forecasting). Benefits Of Working For Honeywell Aerospace In addition to a performance-driven salary, cutting-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell Aerospace employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. About Us Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution. Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

You will not be starting from zero. We have early workflows live in production, more proofs of concept in the oven, and working hypotheses about how all of this should fit together. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the RL teams</strong></h2> <p>Our Reinforcement Learning teams lead Anthropic's reinforcement learning research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to all Claude models, with significant impacts on the autonomy and coding capabilities of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5. Our work spans several key areas:</p> <ul> <li>Developing systems that enable models to use computers effectively</li> <li>Advancing code generation through reinforcement learning</li> <li>Pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models</li> <li>Building scalable RL infrastructure and training methodologies</li> <li>Enhancing model reasoning capabilities</li> </ul> <p>We collaborate closely with Anthropic's alignment and frontier red teams to ensure our systems are both capable and safe. jobs.jd_excerpt: EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more. We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com. Machine Learning Engineer We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our ML team at EvenUp. You'll develop and deploy models that power Piai™, our proprietary claims-intelligence platform, with a focus on machine learning, natural-language processing, and generative AI. Working alongside senior ML engineers, data scientists, and legal subject-matter experts, you'll turn raw legal and medical data into production-ready models that directly improve outcomes for personal-injury clients. What You'll Do Explore, implement, and benchmark ML, NLP, and generative AI methods - including LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, and document understanding. Clean, annotate, and transform structured and unstructured case data, and build reusable datasets and data loaders. Design experiments, run A/B tests, analyze results, and communicate findings to product and engineering teams. Help integrate models into our production systems, partnering with ML platform engineers on testing, monitoring, and scaling. Pair with product managers, legal analysts, and software engineers to translate real problems into ML solutions and measurable improvements. Stay current with research in LLMs, representation learning, and prompt engineering, and share what you learn with the team. What You Bring B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Computational Linguistics, or a related field. Solid grounding in ML fundamentals - supervised and unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, overfitting and regularization. Hands-on experience with NLP or generative AI techniques - transformers, embeddings, sequence-to-sequence models, or LLMs. Proficiency in Python and ML/NLP libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or spaCy. Familiarity with SQL and basic data engineering concepts - ETL, versioned datasets, notebooks. Strong analytical thinking, clear communication, and eagerness to learn and iterate quickly in a fast-moving startup. Ability to work hybrid (3 days your choice) in our San Francisco or Toronto, Canada office. Nice to Have Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP). Experience with experiment-tracking tools (Weights & Biases, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, MLflow). Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience in a high-growth startup environment. Benefits & Perks: As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including: Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family. Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness. Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability. 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province. A home office stipend. 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees. Paid parental leave. A local in-person meet-up program. Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto. (Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees) Notice to Candidates: To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page . Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy. EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Compensation Range: $130K - $205K

jobs.jd_excerpt: The American Lung Association has an excellent opportunity for a Data Engineer. Working as a member of the Information Technology department, you will join an outstanding group of professionals dedicated to our mission: to save lives by improving lung health and preventing lung disease through research, education, and advocacy. The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and optimizing data platforms that support enterprise analytics, reporting, and AI/ML initiatives. This role combines data engineering, data modeling, and data architecture responsibilities to deliver scalable, reliable, and governed data solutions. The Data Engineer works closely with business stakeholders and governance teams to translate business requirements into scalable, well-governed data solutions that support organizational objectives. Location: Chicago, Illinois Hybrid: The position is located at the American Lung Association’s Chicago, Illinois office and will be a combination of in-person and virtual work. Responsibilities Data Engineering Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from diverse sources (APIs, SaaS platforms, databases, streaming sources, flat files). Develop and optimize batch and real-time data workflows using modern orchestration and transformation tools. Ensure data quality, reliability, and observability through automated testing, monitoring, and alerting. Partner with Data Team and business stakeholders to develop curated, analytics-ready data sources that enable self-service consumption. Data Modeling Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models that support transactional, analytical, and reporting workloads. Build and maintain semantic models and reusable datasets that make data intuitive and accessible for business users and downstream analytics tools. Apply dimensional modeling (Kimball, data vault, or 3NF) approaches as appropriate to the use case. Define and maintain data standards, naming conventions, and metadata documentation. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate domain knowledge into reusable, governed data structures. Data Architecture Contribute to the enterprise data architecture roadmap, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, and streaming patterns. Help evaluate and recommend tools, platforms, and design patterns that best fit enterprise needs. Support the design of data integration, master data, and reference data strategies aligned with enterprise architecture principles. Champion data governance, lineage, security, and compliance best practices in partnership with governance teams. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building production data pipelines. 1–2+ years of data modeling experience across OLTP and/or OLAP systems. Strong proficiency in SQL and solid programming skills in Python or similar OOP languages. Experience working with at least one cloud data platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and a modern warehouse or Lakehouse environment (Snowflake, MS Fabric, Databricks, etc.). Hands-on experience building data integrations to a data lake/warehouse environment, either via coding (SQL, etc..) or commercial ELT/ETL tools. Working knowledge of dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions. Familiarity with semantic modeling concepts and developing curated data sources for analytics and BI consumption. Understanding of data governance, security, lineage, and metadata management concepts. Experience with CI/CD, Git, and version-controlled development for data workloads. Strong communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders and the ability to translate business needs and logic to technical workflows. Must have a valid Driver’s license and your own reliable transportation with the ability to travel within assigned area 5% of the time for meetings and conferences, as well as the flexibility to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends with some overnights required. Ability to lift and carry 25 lbs. (event supplies). Consistent with its mission, the American Lung Association maintains a smoke-free workplace; all employees must abstain from tobacco use in any form, including vaping. Preferred Experience designing semantic layers or analytics-ready datasets to support self-service BI and reporting. Familiarity with Data Vault 2.0, Data Mesh, or medallion architecture patterns. Exposure to streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, event-based ingestion, structured streaming). Experience working in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, insurance) and with PII/PHI data. Relevant certifications in cloud data engineering, data management, or data modeling (e.g., CDMP, cloud-provider data engineering certifications). Interest in growing into a senior data engineering or data architecture role over time. Compensation: Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. The target hiring range for this position is between $108,000 and $120,000 per annum. Insurance - Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in our medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as voluntary plans for critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, short-term disability and supplemental life/AD&D insurance. jobs.jd_excerpt: DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together. Summary The Data Engineer, Solutions & Data role designs, builds, and operates data pipelines and data integration processes that translate raw data into trusted, usable datasets for analytics, reporting, and downstream solutions. The role focuses on operationalizing pipelines with governance and service expectations (SLAs), improving data quality and reusability, and enabling secure access to integrated data in support of business initiatives. In current initiatives, data engineering includes consolidating data from multiple sources into a central SQL-based integration point and performing field mapping and transformations, so solution teams can consume data consistently. Location This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule. Responsibilities Data Pipeline Engineering & Integration Build and operationalize data pipelines across heterogeneous environments, aligning to governance principles and service expectations (SLAs). Build and maintain ingestion, transformation, and publication of pipelines (data engineering practice) to deliver analytics-ready data. Consolidate data from multiple sources into a centralized integration point (e.g., a single SQL Server instance) and manage field mappings and transformations to support consistent downstream consumption. Data Platform & Storage Design and implement data pipelines using Azure data technologies (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Event Hubs, SSIS) to ingest, process, and deliver data from sources such as APIs and other systems. Build and maintain data warehousing capabilities (e.g., Azure Synapse Analytics) to support analytics and reporting workloads. Data Quality, Reliability & Operations Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data issues including data quality, integrity, latency, and security concerns; apply monitoring and operational best practices to keep pipelines reliable and performant. Contribute to data quality and governance practices, including profiling datasets, defining quality rules, and establishing monitoring/remediation approaches. Collaboration & Delivery (Agile Pod Model) Work cross-functionally with engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data solutions that support sprint-based delivery. Support pod-level delivery by producing reusable data assets and integration components that can be leveraged across multiple initiatives. Desired Skills Proficiency in SQL and Python. Data pipeline tooling and cloud data services experience (Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Event Hubs, SSIS). Data warehousing experience (Azure Synapse Analytics) and strong fundamentals in data modeling, warehousing, and governance. Scripting/automation skills (PowerShell and related tooling) for platform operations and troubleshooting. Preferred experience includes familiarity with additional programming languages such as Java, Scala, or Go; experience integrating data from multiple enterprise source systems into a central SQL-based integration layer; and familiarity with DataOps concepts and operating in cross-functional teams that include data engineering personas. The measures of success for this role include delivering data pipelines with trusted, quality data with agreed service levels, enabling faster onboarding of new data and more consistent analytics/AI consumption and creating reduced manual effort through reusable integrations and standardized transformations, improved data reliability and operational readiness. Minimum Education High School or GED Preferred Education Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Minimum Years Of Experience 3 years of experience in data engineering and/or data platform engineering (pipelines, integration, and operational support). Essential Job Expectations All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include: Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences. Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner. Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards. Comply with firm policies and procedures. Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment. Physical Demands Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international. Work Environment The selected candidate will have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement combining remote and in-office work. The specific arrangement will be determined at the time of hiring and may be modified at the firm's discretion. Compensation & Benefits The firm's expected hiring range for this position is $100,787 - $160,255, depending on the candidate's geographic location, experience, skills, educational background, and overall qualifications. DLA Piper offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, and additional benefits. Application Process Interested candidates must apply directly online. Application materials sent via email will not be accepted. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position or participate in the selection process. jobs.jd_excerpt:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. About the Team Ads Data Engineering is at the core of building a data ecosystem that powers Netflix's understanding and decision-making about the impact of ads on our business. This team builds rich, connected, and easily accessible data products spanning ad inventory, forecasting, targeting, ad serving, pacing, and more. This role will lead the Ads Signals & Measurement team across three core areas: * Conversion & Attribution: Building the data and attribution capabilities that connect advertising exposure to outcomes, powering conversion measurement and ML-based optimization. * Measurement Data Foundations: Building the data foundations that power our first-party measurement solutions across the full funnel, including incrementality, lift, experimentation, and third-party measurement studies. * Audience Onboarding & Identity: Enabling audience onboarding, identity resolution, and rich signal generation to power audience and targeting solutions. Horizontally, the team connects these areas through a data flywheel where signals, identity, measurement, attribution, and optimization continuously reinforce one another. This role sits at the intersection of these domains, ensuring they come together as a cohesive data ecosystem that powers both measurement and performance optimization. jobs.jd_excerpt: <div class="content-intro"><p>Latitude AI (<a href="http://lat.ai">lat.ai</a>) is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.&nbsp;</p> <p>When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – <strong><em>all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.</em></strong></p> <p>As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.</p></div><p><strong>Meet the team:</strong></p> <p>The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale.&nbsp; We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that’s cloud-agnostic as well as capable of running on-prem.&nbsp; The results of these simulations is business-critical for us - they’re used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in-vehicle testing.&nbsp; We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end-to-end capabilities.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we’re releasing a safe product.&nbsp; You’ll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework.&nbsp; In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services.&nbsp; In terms of analysis, we’re constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance.&nbsp; You’ll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information.&nbsp; Then armed with that information, you’ll implement solutions to increase efficiency.</li> <li>It’s not enough to have a framework that is functional - it needs to be intuitive and easy to use.&nbsp; We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction - both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results.&nbsp; VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>We also can’t build it all, so we want to make the framework well-documented and as self-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions).&nbsp; For example, when there’s a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly.</li> <li>In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting.&nbsp; You’ll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage.</li> <li>Once we’ve run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs.&nbsp; Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV’s performance; these metrics could range from low-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high-level business objectives.&nbsp; You’ll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll need to succeed:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)</li> <li>Expertise in writing Python code that’s efficient, well-documented, and well-tested</li> <li>2+ years’ experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment</li> <li>2+ years’ experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services</li> <li>Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming</li> <li>Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have (optional):</strong></p> <ul> <li>C++ development experience</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation packages</li> <li>High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance</li> <li>Health savings account with available employer match</li> <li>Employer-matched 401(k)

The Core Data Science team builds the products and data assets that let teams across Zoox measure and improve the autonomy and operational performance of our fleet.
